structured_output.outcome: None stated. The request gives a competitive rationale ("every university site has one"), not a learner outcome. Steelmanned: learners get answers to programme, payment and deadline questions in one conversational place without waiting on support; prospects see parity with other university sites. Which of those two you mean decides the product — logged-in learner assistant vs public-site marketing bot — and they are different builds on different surfaces.

urgency.claim: Needed this sprint; every university site has one and ours doesn't; quick with existing APIs.
urgency.evidence: None supplied. No support-ticket volume, no learner complaint, no lost-prospect data, no deadline, no contract or launch date. 'Quick with the APIs we already have' names no API. The platform context shows Nexa already answers programme, payment and deadline questions — so the gap as stated ('ours doesn't') is not confirmed.
urgency.assessment: Unsubstantiated. The sprint is committed and the request arrived out of process on Tuesday; triage is Thursday. Nothing in the request or the platform context shows learner harm from waiting one triage cycle. If there is a date behind this (board, accreditation visit, marketing launch), that is the missing evidence and would change the assessment.

duplicate.why: No open issues were shortlisted. Not a duplicate of an issue — but it may be a duplicate of a capability: Nexa exists in the platform context and covers the most likely question set. Confirm at triage whether the request is 'expose/extend Nexa' before opening a new issue.

size.risk: Unsizeable as written; XL is the honest band for 'AI chatbot' with no scope. If the answer is 'put Nexa in the myNXU shell as a chat entry point, same question set', the band drops to M (one person, one sprint). If it must answer from Canvas coursework/grades, read the learner's invoices via the payments provider, or send learner-record data to an external model vendor, it stays XL: that adds a vendor selection, a per-conversation cost budget, a data-handling rule, and a Canvas read path whose availability the team lists as unknown.

questions.text: BLOCKING — Is this Nexa? Nexa already answers programme, payment and deadline questions from the catalogue and the learner's record. Do you want (a) Nexa surfaced as a chat entry point in myNXU, (b) Nexa extended to new question types — name them, or (c) a different bot on the public site for prospects? Pick one; each is a different build.

BLOCKING — What must it answer, for whom, and what counts as done? Give the ten questions it must handle on day one and who is asking (logged-in learner, prospect, both). 'AI chatbot' is not a scope; ten questions is.

BLOCKING — Data rule: may the learner's own record (grades from Canvas, open invoices, ID-document status) be sent to an external model vendor to generate an answer? If yes, under what terms; if no, the bot answers from the catalogue only. The team cannot set this rule.
BLOCKING only if (b) or (c): who pays per conversation? A hosted model has a per-request cost that scales with learners. Name a monthly ceiling or name the vendor already contracted.
Which APIs do you mean by 'the APIs we already have'? If you mean a specific vendor account or key that exists, name it — the team does not have one listed.

What happens when the bot is wrong or cannot answer — who is on the other end of the handoff, and during what hours? A support team, a ticket, or nothing. This decides whether the bot creates support load or removes it.
Is there a date behind 'this sprint' — board meeting, accreditation visit, marketing launch? If so, that is the urgency evidence; supply it.
Can Nexa be embedded in the myNXU shell as-is, and what does it need from the shell (learner identity, session) to answer from the learner's record? Confirm in refinement.

Is item-level Canvas data (module completion, coursework) readable from myNXU today? Platform context lists this as unknown; if the bot must answer coursework questions, this is a prerequisite, not a feature.
Can the payments provider's open-invoice state be read per learner for a conversational answer, or only the events already on the deadline rail (invoice issued/paid)?
Where does the chat live in the shell (persistent widget, page, deadline-rail entry), and how does it hand off to a human without losing the conversation? Bring an option to refinement.
What does the bot say when it will not answer (data rule says no, or out of scope)? Refusal copy and escalation path.

structured_output.requester_message:
You asked for an AI chatbot this sprint because other university sites have one. Two things before this can be triaged on Thursday.

First: we already have one. Nexa answers programme, payment and deadline questions from the catalogue and the learner's own record. So I need you to say which of these you mean — (a) put Nexa in front of learners in myNXU as a chat entry point, (b) make Nexa answer new kinds of questions (tell me which), or (c) a bot on the public site for prospects who aren't logged in. These are three different builds. (a) is roughly one person for one sprint. (b) and (c) are bigger than a sprint and need decisions only you can make: whether a learner's grades, invoices or ID status may be sent to an outside AI vendor to produce an answer, and what we're willing to pay per conversation.

Second: the sprint is already committed. If this goes in now, something the team has committed to comes out, and you would be choosing which at Thursday's triage — I will not pull anything without you naming it. If there is a date driving this (board, accreditation, a launch), tell me the date and I will weigh it against what's in flight.

What I need from you before Thursday triage:
1. Which of (a), (b), (c).
2. The ten questions it must answer on day one, and who is asking.
3. Yes or no: may learner-record data go to an external model vendor.
4. If (b) or (c): a monthly spend ceiling, or the name of the vendor account you believe we already have.
5. Who handles the handoff when the bot can't answer.

With those five answers it goes to Thursday triage as a sized item. Without them it goes to triage as a question, and the answer will be the same list.
